note: Integer rupees everywhere -- no floats, no toFixed. price <= mrp. The discount percentage is DERIVED, never stored. `new`, `sale`, `low-stock` and `sold-out` are DERIVED too: `badges` holds only what a human chose. Variants carry `delta`, never a price, and only the SIZE axis may carry a non-zero one. `swatch` is a literal hex and is the one permitted literal colour in this project -- it is product data, not theme, and tokens.pl never sees it because tokens.pl reads only styles/*.css. A product with no `img` key renders generated artwork from art.js; adding `img` is the photography swap path. PRICES ARE ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT REAL -- see shop.json placeholder.

products.desc: Printed in Bagru with carved teak blocks and the iron-black dye that village still mixes by hand, then washed four times so it arrives soft rather than stiff. The indigo deepens for the first few washes and then holds. Comes with two matching pillow covers.
products.name: Kalamkari Indigo Bed Cover
products.shortDesc: Hand-blocked cotton with two pillow covers. Washed four times before it ships.

specs.v: Gentle machine wash cold, dry in shade

products.desc: A repeating floral buti in soft madder and turmeric on an unbleached cotton ground. The print is deliberately a little uneven -- each block is placed by eye, and a perfectly regular repeat would mean it came off a roller.
products.name: Bagru Floral Bed Cover
products.shortDesc: Floral buti in madder and turmeric on unbleached cotton.

products.desc: A dense garden print -- creepers, parrots and small blossoms -- in the Jaipur palette of rose, pistachio and ivory. Heavier than our other covers at 200 TC, which makes it the one to buy for a room that gets cold.
products.name: Jaipur Garden Bed Cover
products.shortDesc: A dense garden print in rose and pistachio. Our heaviest cover at 200 TC.

specs.v: Gentle machine wash cold, do not bleach

products.desc: Fine Sanganeri printing on 300 thread-count cotton -- a small, regular buti that reads almost as a texture from across the room. The set includes a fitted sheet with deep pockets, which is the detail most bedsheets get wrong.
products.name: Sanganeri Cotton Bedsheet Set
products.shortDesc: 300 TC cotton with a fitted sheet and deep pockets. Two pillow covers.

specs.v: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low

products.desc: Scattered buti in four pastels on a white ground, printed so the spacing never falls into a visible grid. A quiet sheet, meant for a room where something else is already doing the talking.
products.name: Pastel Buti Bedsheet Set
products.shortDesc: Scattered buti in four pastels on white. 220 TC with two pillow covers.

products.desc: A woven chevron in ivory on ivory -- no print at all, the pattern comes from the loom. It is the sheet we reach for when nothing else in the room should have to accommodate it.
products.name: Ivory Chevron Bedsheet Set
products.shortDesc: Woven chevron, ivory on ivory. No print -- the pattern is the weave.

products.desc: Three layers of mulmul muslin quilted together -- light enough for a Mumbai October, warm enough for a Delhi one. It compresses to almost nothing, which is why it is the one that travels.
products.name: Jaipuri Mulmul Dohar
products.shortDesc: Three layers of mulmul muslin. Light enough for October, packs to nothing.

products.desc: Running kantha stitch worked across the whole surface by hand in Bengal, which takes one woman about nine days. The stitches are visibly irregular and that is the point -- a machine quilt is perfectly even and reads as such.
products.name: Kantha Stitch Dohar
products.shortDesc: Hand-worked kantha across the whole surface. About nine days of stitching.

products.desc: Our plainest dohar and our cheapest -- a single block repeated in one colour, no border, no fuss. It exists because not every bed needs a statement on it.
products.name: Bagru Block Dohar
products.shortDesc: One block, one colour, no border. The plain one.

products.desc: Pure wool woven in Kullu, brushed on one side only so it is warm against you and smooth facing out. Heavy -- 2.4 kg -- and meant for a hill winter rather than a plains one.
products.name: Himalayan Wool Blanket
products.shortDesc: Pure Kullu wool, brushed on one side. 2.4 kg, for a real winter.

products.desc: An ikat chevron in a cotton-wool blend, light enough to leave on a sofa all year. The feathered edge where the colours meet is how you know the yarn was dyed before it was woven and not after.
products.name: Ikat Weave Throw Blanket
products.shortDesc: Ikat chevron in a cotton-wool blend. Light enough to live on a sofa.

products.desc: The wide horizontal stripe every Himachali bus seat and every Kullu shawl has worn for a century, in a blanket weight. Scratchier than merino and considerably warmer than it looks.
products.name: Kullu Stripe Blanket
products.shortDesc: The wide Kullu stripe in blanket weight. Warmer than it looks.

products.desc: A cast brass jharokha -- the latticed window a Rajasthani haveli watches the street through -- mounted on a teak back so it hangs flat. Unlacquered, so it will darken; a cut lemon and salt brings it back if you want it bright.
products.name: Brass Jharokha Wall Frame
products.shortDesc: Cast brass lattice window on a teak back. Unlacquered, so it will age.

products.desc: Six wheel-thrown terracotta diyas, unglazed, from a potter in Khurja who has supplied this shape for forty years. They are not identical, because a wheel does not make identical things.
products.name: Terracotta Diya, Set of Six
products.shortDesc: Six wheel-thrown unglazed diyas from Khurja. No two quite alike.

products.desc: A pair of elephants carved from a single block of seasoned teak, trunks up. Hand-carved, so the pair are close but not mirror images -- look at the ears.
products.name: Carved Teak Elephant Pair
products.shortDesc: Hand-carved teak, trunks up. Close to a pair but not mirror images.

products.desc: White marble with a floral inlay of carnelian and malachite, cut and set by hand in Agra by the same families that have done pietra dura since the Taj. Small -- it holds rings and not much else.
products.name: Marble Inlay Trinket Box
products.shortDesc: Agra pietra dura in carnelian and malachite. Holds rings, not much more.

products.desc: A spun brass urli, the shallow bowl Kerala households float flowers and floating wicks in. Ours is 12 inches, which is the size that works on a dining table rather than a courtyard.
products.name: Brass Urli Bowl
products.shortDesc: Spun brass, 12 inches. The size that works on a table, not a courtyard.

products.desc: Cast by the lost-wax method in Bastar, where the wax thread is wound by hand before the bronze goes in -- which is why the surface has that fine ribbed texture and no two castings match. The mould is destroyed to release each piece.
products.name: Dhokra Tribal Figurine
products.shortDesc: Lost-wax bronze from Bastar. The mould is destroyed to release each one.

products.desc: A long block-printed runner in cotton with a hand-knotted fringe at each end. Sized for a six-seater -- 72 inches, which is longer than most runners sold here and the reason this one does not look mean on a full table.
products.name: Block Print Table Runner
products.shortDesc: 72 inches, for a six-seater. Hand-knotted fringe at both ends.

products.desc: Two 16-inch cushion covers with concealed zips, in a heavier cotton than most so they hold their shape on a sofa rather than slumping. Covers only -- the inserts you already have will fit.
products.name: Cotton Cushion Cover, Pair
products.shortDesc: Two 16-inch covers, concealed zips, heavy cotton. Covers only.

products.desc: Jaipur blue pottery, which contains no clay at all -- it is quartz, glass and fuller's earth, fired low, and that is why the blue is that particular blue. Fragile, and it will not survive being knocked off a shelf.
products.name: Blue Pottery Vase
products.shortDesc: Jaipur blue pottery -- quartz, not clay. Fragile, and genuinely so.

products.desc: Chanderi in a dusty rose, with the faint sheen the silk-cotton blend gives and a straight cut that does not need altering. Side slits to the hip, three-quarter sleeves, and pockets -- which Chanderi kurtis almost never have.
products.name: Chanderi Rose Kurti
products.shortDesc: Chanderi silk-cotton, straight cut, three-quarter sleeves. With pockets.

products.desc: Real bandhani -- each dot is a point of cloth tied off by hand before dyeing, and you can still feel the pucker where the thread was. Kutch work, in indigo on an unbleached cotton.
products.name: Indigo Bandhani Kurti
products.shortDesc: Real tied-and-dyed bandhani from Kutch. You can feel where the thread was.

products.desc: Plain ivory cotton, straight, no print and no embroidery. The one you wear under a jacket, or over leggings on a day that is already complicated enough.
products.name: Ivory Cotton Straight Kurti
products.shortDesc: Plain ivory cotton. No print, no embroidery, nothing to think about.

products.desc: Solid mango wood, hand-carved on all four faces, 18 inches high -- which is seat height, so it works as a stool and not only as a plant stand. Heavy enough that it does not skid.
products.name: Carved Mango Wood Stool
products.shortDesc: Solid mango wood, carved on all four faces. 18 in -- genuine seat height.

products.desc: A sheesham frame with a block-printed cotton seat over high-density foam. Lower than the carved stool at 15 inches, which makes it a footstool more than a chair.
products.name: Upholstered Block Print Stool
products.shortDesc: Sheesham frame, block-print seat over foam. 15 in -- a footstool, really.

products.desc: Mango wood with brass sheet inlaid into the top in a jaali pattern. The brass is set flush, so a glass stands on it without rocking -- which is the whole difference between inlay and applique.
products.name: Brass Inlay Side Stool
products.shortDesc: Brass jaali inlaid flush into a mango wood top. A glass stands on it.

products.desc: Woven jute with a cotton lining that lifts out and goes in the wash, which is the part most hampers forget. Holds about two loads and stands up on its own when empty.
products.name: Jute Laundry Hamper
products.shortDesc: Woven jute with a washable cotton liner. Stands up on its own, empty.

products.desc: Cotton canvas over a collapsible wire frame -- it folds to two inches flat, which matters if you are taking it to a hostel or a hotel. Mesh panel on one side so damp clothes do not sour.
products.name: Canvas Foldable Laundry Bag
products.shortDesc: Folds to two inches flat. Mesh panel so damp clothes do not sour.

products.desc: The simplest thing we sell -- a big cotton bag with a drawstring, block-printed. For the back of a cupboard door, or for carrying a week of washing down three flights.
products.name: Cotton Drawstring Laundry Bag
products.shortDesc: A big block-printed cotton bag with a drawstring. That is all it is.

products.desc: Three quilted pouches that nest -- one for cables, one for toiletries, one for the things that have no category. Water-resistant lining, so a leaking shampoo bottle is an inconvenience rather than a disaster.
products.name: Travel Organiser, Set of Three
products.shortDesc: Three nesting quilted pouches with a water-resistant lining.

specs.v: 10 x 7 in, 8 x 5 in, 6 x 4 in

products.desc: A roll with four zip pockets and a padded ring bar, in quilted cotton. Rolls shut and ties, so nothing migrates in a suitcase -- the failure mode every flat jewellery case has.
products.name: Quilted Jewellery Roll
products.shortDesc: Four zip pockets and a padded ring bar. Rolls shut and ties.

products.desc: A flat A4 pouch for passports, tickets and the sheaf of paper Indian bureaucracy still runs on. Cotton outside, water-resistant inside, one zip.
products.name: Document Pouch
products.shortDesc: Flat A4 pouch for passports and paperwork. One zip, nothing clever.

products.desc: Block-printed cotton with a wipeable lining and a flat base, so it stands open on a bathroom shelf instead of collapsing the moment you let go of it.
products.name: Block Print Makeup Pouch
products.shortDesc: Flat base, so it stands open on a shelf instead of collapsing.

products.desc: Quilted velvet with a gold-tone zip, deeper than it looks -- it takes a full brush set standing up. The velvet marks if it gets wet, which is the trade for how it feels.
products.name: Quilted Velvet Vanity Pouch
products.shortDesc: Deeper than it looks -- takes a brush set standing up. Velvet marks if wet.

products.desc: Small enough for a handbag -- a lipstick, a kajal, a compact and nothing else. Sold because the large one kept being bought for a job it was too big for.
products.name: Mini Cosmetic Pouch
products.shortDesc: A lipstick, a kajal, a compact. Deliberately too small for more.

products.desc: Two flat zip pouches in different sizes, printed cotton. Not specialised for anything, which is why they end up holding everything -- charger bricks, medicines, a spare mask.
products.name: Zip Utility Pouch, Set of Two
products.shortDesc: Two flat zip pouches, two sizes. Specialised for nothing on purpose.

products.desc: Padded, with four elastic loops and a mesh pocket, so a charger and three cables come out untangled. The loops are sewn at both ends -- single-stitched loops pull out inside a month.
products.name: Cable & Charger Pouch
products.shortDesc: Four elastic loops, sewn at both ends, and a mesh pocket.

products.desc: A small zip pouch with a split ring riveted inside, so keys hang rather than sink. Takes coins, a card and a house key, and nothing else will fit.
products.name: Coin & Key Pouch
products.shortDesc: A riveted split ring inside, so keys hang instead of sinking.

products.desc: Zardozi embroidery on raw silk, worked by hand in Lucknow -- the metallic thread is couched down rather than stitched through, which is why the back is clean. Detachable chain, so it works as a clutch or on the shoulder.
products.name: Embroidered Clutch Purse
products.shortDesc: Hand zardozi on raw silk, Lucknow. Detachable chain.

products.desc: Quilted cotton with a flap and a magnetic snap, lined in printed cotton rather than the usual black polyester. Light -- 180 grams -- which you notice after a day of carrying it.
products.name: Quilted Cotton Purse
products.shortDesc: 180 grams, lined in printed cotton rather than black polyester.

products.desc: Banarasi brocade over a stiffened frame with a kiss-lock clasp. Small and formal -- it holds a phone, a card and a lipstick, and is honest about being for an evening rather than a day.
products.name: Brocade Evening Purse
products.shortDesc: Banarasi brocade on a kiss-lock frame. A phone, a card, a lipstick.

products.desc: A structured jacquard body on a reinforced base with four metal feet, so it stands up and stays clean set down on a floor. Two inside pockets and a zip divider down the middle.
products.name: Structured Jacquard Handbag
products.shortDesc: Reinforced base with metal feet, so it stands and stays clean.

products.desc: Block-printed canvas with full-grain leather handles and base corners -- the two places a cloth bag always fails first. The leather will scuff and darken; the canvas will not.
products.name: Leather-Trim Block Print Handbag
products.shortDesc: Leather on the handles and base corners -- where cloth bags fail first.

products.desc: Hand-kantha-stitched over patched cotton, with a long adjustable strap. Soft-bodied and unstructured -- it takes the shape of what is in it, which some people want and some very much do not.
products.name: Kantha Shoulder Bag
products.shortDesc: Soft-bodied and unstructured. It takes the shape of what is in it.

products.desc: Heavy 12oz cotton canvas with a jute base panel and cotton webbing handles stitched up the full height of the bag, not just at the rim. That single detail is why it will outlast three of the ones sold at railway stations.
products.name: Canvas Jute Tote
products.shortDesc: Handles stitched the full height, not just at the rim. That is the point.

products.desc: Block-printed cotton, lighter than the canvas tote and foldable to the size of a paperback. The one that lives folded in another bag for the shopping you did not plan to do.
products.name: Block Print Everyday Tote
products.shortDesc: Folds to the size of a paperback. Lives inside another bag.

products.desc: A padded sleeve sewn into the back wall takes a 15-inch laptop, and there are four more pockets in front of it. Structured enough to stand on a desk, which a soft tote full of a laptop never is.
products.name: Laptop Tote with Pockets
products.shortDesc: Padded 15-inch sleeve sewn into the back wall. Stands up on a desk.

products.name: Gift Card, Rs 1,000
products.shortDesc: Valid one year. Issued by hand after we confirm your order.

products.desc: Two and a half thousand rupees, which buys a dohar and a cushion pair with change, or most of a bed cover. Issued by hand after we confirm your order.
products.name: Gift Card, Rs 2,500
products.shortDesc: A dohar and a cushion pair with change. Issued by hand.

products.desc: Five thousand rupees. Enough for the Kalamkari bed cover with its king upgrade, or a wool blanket, or a great deal of smaller things. Issued by hand after we confirm your order.
products.name: Gift Card, Rs 5,000
products.shortDesc: A king-size bed cover, or a wool blanket, or many smaller things.

products.desc: A shopping voucher for fifteen hundred rupees, printed on card and posted to you or to them, with a hand-written note if you tell us what to write. Allow a week for the post.
products.name: Shopping Voucher, Rs 1,500
products.shortDesc: Printed on card and posted, with a hand-written note if you want one.

products.desc: Three thousand rupees on printed card, posted. The one people buy for a wedding, because it arrives as an object rather than an email.
products.name: Shopping Voucher, Rs 3,000
products.shortDesc: Arrives as an object rather than an email. The wedding one.

products.desc: Ten thousand rupees, our largest. Posted on card in an envelope with a wax seal. For a house-warming, usually, and occasionally for an apology.
products.name: Shopping Voucher, Rs 10,000
products.shortDesc: Our largest. Posted on card, in an envelope with a wax seal.
